source.title: In Memoriam: François Courtès
source.content:
Our friend and fellow cuber François Courtès died in the evening of September 7, 2016, from a cerebrovascular accident. He was 45 years old. It is very sad news.

In our [In Memoriam: François Courtès](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=9&t=2028) fellow cubers express their feelings and bring back memories about François. He will be missed by many of us.

translation.title: 悼念 François Courtès
translation.content:
我们的朋友、魔友 François Courtès 于 2016 年 9 月 7 日晚因脑血管意外去世，年仅 45 岁。这是一个令人悲痛的消息。

在[《悼念 François Courtès》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=9&t=2028)主题中，魔友们表达哀思，回忆与 François 相处的往事。我们中的许多人都会怀念他。
